```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)

source(here::here("R/legislature/utils.R"))
source(here::here("R/legislature/ui_helpers.R"))
```

```{r}
# Load data
people <- read_csv(here::here("legiscan/files_ga91_derived/people.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(!is.na(first_name), first_name != "")
sponsors <- read_csv(here::here("legiscan/files_ga91_derived/sponsors.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
votes <- read_csv(here::here("legiscan/files_ga91_derived/votes.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
rollcalls <- read_csv(here::here("legiscan/files_ga91_derived/rollcalls.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Load processed voting statistics
legislator_stats <- read_rds(here::here("data/legislature/votes/legislator_stats_91st_ga.rds"))

# Load simplified district geometries for maps
senate_districts <- read_rds(here::here("data/legislature/districts/senate.rds"))
house_districts  <- read_rds(here::here("data/legislature/districts/house.rds"))
```

```{r}
# Identify former legislators via duplicate districts (shared helper in utils.R).
# When a legislator resigns or passes away, LegiScan adds their replacement to
# the same district; the member who stopped voting first is the former one.
former_ids <- classify_district_turnover(people, votes, rollcalls) |>
  filter(is_former) |>
  pull(people_id)

active_people <- people |> filter(!people_id %in% former_ids)

# Chamber party counts (active members only)
n_house_R  <- active_people |> filter(role == "Rep", party == "R") |> nrow()
n_house_D  <- active_people |> filter(role == "Rep", party == "D") |> nrow()
n_senate_R <- active_people |> filter(role == "Sen", party == "R") |> nrow()
n_senate_D <- active_people |> filter(role == "Sen", party == "D") |> nrow()
```

```{r}
# Header: hero + chamber party-split bars
party_split_bar <- function(label, r, d) {
  total <- r + d
  div(style = "text-align:right",
    div(class = "ia-split-label", label),
    div(class = "ia-split-track",
      div(style = sprintf("width:%.1f%%; background:#A8433A", 100 * r / total)),
      div(style = sprintf("width:%.1f%%; background:#3F5B93", 100 * d / total))
    ),
    div(class = "ia-split-count",
      HTML(sprintf('<span style="color:#A8433A">%d R</span> &middot; <span style="color:#3F5B93">%d D</span>', r, d)))
  )
}

div(class = "ia-hero-row",
  div(
    h1("Legislators"),
    HTML(sprintf("<p class='ia-lead'><strong>%d</strong> members serving in the House and Senate.</p>",
                 nrow(active_people)))
  ),
  div(style = "display:flex; gap:1.75rem",
    party_split_bar("House",  n_house_R,  n_house_D),
    party_split_bar("Senate", n_senate_R, n_senate_D)
  )
)
```

```{r}
party_fill <- function(party) {
  case_when(party == "R" ~ "#A8433A", party == "D" ~ "#3F5B93", TRUE ~ "#CCCCCC")
}

house_map_sf <- house_districts |>
  left_join(
    active_people |>
      filter(role == "Rep") |>
      rowwise() |>
      mutate(
        district_num = parse_district_number(district),
        filename     = get_legislator_filename(people_id, people),
        fill_color   = party_fill(party)
      ) |>
      ungroup() |>
      select(district_num, name, party, district, filename, fill_color),
    by = c("District" = "district_num")
  )

senate_map_sf <- senate_districts |>
  left_join(
    active_people |>
      filter(role == "Sen") |>
      rowwise() |>
      mutate(
        district_num = parse_district_number(district),
        filename     = get_legislator_filename(people_id, people),
        fill_color   = party_fill(party)
      ) |>
      ungroup() |>
      select(district_num, name, party, district, filename, fill_color),
    by = c("District" = "district_num")
  )
```

```{r}
# Activity stats for each legislator
sponsor_counts <- sponsors |>
  count(people_id, name = "bills_sponsored")

# Bills where legislator is the only sponsor
sole_sponsor_counts <- sponsors |>
  group_by(bill_id) |>
  filter(n() == 1, position == 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  count(people_id, name = "sole_sponsored")

# Floor votes only (exclude committee report votes)
floor_rollcalls <- rollcalls |>
  filter(!str_detect(description, "Report$")) |>
  pull(roll_call_id)

vote_counts <- votes |>
  filter(roll_call_id %in% floor_rollcalls) |>
  count(people_id, name = "votes_cast")

build_chamber <- function(role_code) {
  people |>
    filter(role == role_code) |>
    left_join(sponsor_counts, by = "people_id") |>
    left_join(sole_sponsor_counts, by = "people_id") |>
    left_join(vote_counts, by = "people_id") |>
    left_join(
      legislator_stats |> select(people_id, with_party_pct, participation_rate),
      by = "people_id"
    ) |>
    replace_na(list(bills_sponsored = 0, sole_sponsored = 0, votes_cast = 0)) |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      filename  = get_legislator_filename(people_id, people),
      name_link = str_glue("<a href='{filename}.html'>{name}</a>"),
      is_former = people_id %in% former_ids
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    arrange(district) |>
    select(name_link, party, district, bills_sponsored, sole_sponsored,
           votes_cast, with_party_pct, participation_rate, is_former)
}

senators        <- build_chamber("Sen")
representatives  <- build_chamber("Rep")

chamber_map <- function(map_sf) {
  leaflet(map_sf, height = 460) |>
    addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
    addPolygons(
      fillColor   = ~ifelse(is.na(fill_color), "#CCCCCC", fill_color),
      fillOpacity = 0.7,
      color       = "#444444",
      weight      = 1,
      label       = ~paste0(name, " (", party, ") — ", district),
      popup       = ~paste0(
        "<b>", name, "</b> (", party, ")<br>",
        "<b>District:</b> ", district, "<br>",
        "<a href='", filename, ".html'>View Profile →</a>"
      ),
      highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, fillOpacity = 0.9, bringToFront = TRUE)
    ) |>
    addLegend(
      position = "bottomright",
      colors   = c("#A8433A", "#3F5B93"),
      labels   = c("Republican", "Democrat"),
      title    = "Party",
      opacity  = 0.9
    )
}
```
